newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Futuris markets A$150 mln bond issue.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Futuris markets A$150 mln bond issue.

text.p: Diversified manufacturer Futuris Corp Ltd said it was marketing a A$150 million bond issue, managed by SBC Warburg, which was expected to be finalised on December 20.
Futuris general manager, finance and administration, Tony Davis told Reuters the issue was being marketed to Australian institutions in the unrated note market.
The term and pricing had yet to be set, but it was likely to be five to seven years, with the company favouring a fixed rate coupon structure, he said.

Futuris managing director Alan Newman told Reuters the issue was designed to restructure the long-time borrowings of Futuris and its takeover target, pastoral house Elders Australian Ltd in which it now had an 84.25 percent stake.
